programs.note: Chartered 2026-09-03 by the successor research-direction document (section 2.2), reshaped by K1 amendment 2026-09-04 (g1)(2) and by the operator ruling 'a3, b2' of 2026-09-06. TWO LEGS, one program, RESEARCH-ONLY - no manifest, no weights, no envelope, no book (the runner's kills are book kills). Leg A: SPY announcement-day sign excess over the PIT vol-implied null Phi(mu/sigma) (never 0.5; measured 0.52325), raw equity_daily tape 2010-01-04 -> 2026-07-03 (4,149 sessions), TWO members under Benjamini-Hochberg at FDR 0.05 - FOMC alone (123 scored events) and a merged NFP+CPI macro-data member (364) per ruling (b2). Leg B: post-FOMC 50-session drift on IEF (primary) with TLT as a sign contrast, PIT total-return tape equity_daily_tr 2016-01-04 -> 2026-07-03 (2,639 sessions each), CONDITIONED per ruling (a3) on the sign of the announcement-day IEF return - Brooks-Katz-Lustig's drift follows the policy surprise and the unconditional mean surprise is ~0 by construction, so the unconditional form averages the effect away; 71 scored events. Events come from a frozen, provenance-pinned, git-tracked file observe/calendars/macro-events-v1.json (sha256 a1f03a5725f7c1d688ce90235985c2df94c246ab68a16048107cb0afe34869d7): 526 scheduled announcements, 518 SCOREABLE (FOMC 131, NFP 192, CPI 195), 14 pinned sources, no registry series and no cron. Family 4 raw / 2 clustered, declared not computed (the two Leg-A members are measured on disjoint date sets and the legs differ in instrument, horizon and statistic). Registered falsifier: era_sign over three calendar thirds per leg (min_era_events 30 Leg A / 15 Leg B, both set from measured era counts), plus the TLT contrast sharing IEF's sign. Measured power: P(PASS) 0.025 (A/FOMC, whose registered prior says the effect died after 2015), 0.067 (A/MACRO after a 1/2 post-publication haircut), 0.225 (B/IEF). Pre-registration FROZEN at commit A 22e43df2 (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-announcement-day-spy-prereg.md), with one prose-only forward correction 8d21c0b6 that named commit A's sha and its eight ancestors precisely (no rule, constant, era boundary, threshold or sha moved; the fenced JSON block is byte-identical); both mirror-pushed BEFORE any evaluation existed. The evaluation was an operator fence and ran only under the dated ruling 'A: run' (govern/operator-inbox.md, commit 5d9be767), which authorised this ONE frozen evaluation headless and let the three disclosed deviations stand. Any member PASS -> ACTIVE, none -> CONCLUDED; none passed. Promotion is declared before the fact and is cost-constrained: at the platform default 10 bp/side a Leg-A book pays ~600 bp/yr against a ~330 bp/yr premium, so a promotion needs a justified costs.overrides entry for SPY or there is no book.

Evaluated under the operator's dated ruling 'A: run' (5d9be767); result artifact govern/receipts/announcement-day-spy-result.json; the evaluator re-verified rule_sha256 47dffb35... and calendar_sha256 a1f03a57... against the bytes before computing. Leg A (SPY announcement-day sign excess over the PIT vol-implied null 0.52325, raw equity_daily tape 2010-01-04->2026-07-03, two members under Benjamini-Hochberg at FDR 0.05, rank-1 bar p1 < 0.025): FOMC e -0.01919, p1 0.8060, n 123, era thirds +0.0195 / -0.0487 / -0.0216 -> era_sign FAILED; MACRO (NFP+CPI merged per ruling b2) e +0.04268, p1 0.1720, n 364, era thirds +0.0146 / +0.0770 / +0.0315 -> era_sign ok but BH not rejected. Leg B (post-FOMC 50-session IEF drift on the PIT total-return tape 2016-01-04->2026-07-03, conditioned per ruling a3 on the sign of the announcement-day IEF return, one test at one-sided 0.025): e +0.00117, p1 0.4070, n 71 (60 dropped by the burn-in and the forward requirement; 45 long, 26 short), TLT contrast +0.00224 AGREED in sign so the contrast kill did not fire, era thirds +0.00022 / +0.00496 / -0.00210 -> era_sign FAILED. Read: A/FOMC reproduced its own registered prior in shape - Kurov-Wolfe-Gilbert 2021 say the equity pre-FOMC drift died after 2015, and era 1 is the only positive third with both post-2015 thirds negative, so era_sign failing is the falsifier agreeing with the literature. A/MACRO is the informative near-miss: the Savor-Wilson direction, positive in all three eras, the only member to clear era_sign, but p1 0.172 against a 0.025 bar. The pre-registered power table was optimistic and the bootstrap is why: section 4's iid SE sqrt(0.25/n) = 2.62pp at n=364 would have put +4.27pp at p ~ 0.052, while the registered moving-block bootstrap (block 24 = one year of macro events) returned p1 0.172, an effective SE near 4.5pp, ~1.7x the iid figure - announcement outcomes are positively correlated within a year, so every P(PASS) in section 4 is an upper bound. Later pre-registrations using a block bootstrap must size power off a block-resampled SE, not sqrt(p(1-p)/n). Type II, as pre-registered: this window separates only ~9pp (A/FOMC) or ~7pp (A/MACRO) of hit-rate excess from the null at the BH bar against a literature effect of ~2.4pp before the post-publication haircut, so a DIE here is weak evidence of absence - the claim is dead as registered, the announcement premium is not measured to be zero. No re-run of this frozen window; a changed rule, tape, calendar, conditioner or universe is a new program id. Slot 2 has no live program (K3 2026-11-30 met early by the pre-registration itself).
